AccelerationBlendSmoothing_RaisingThisDo.value: Makes acceleration camera effects engage and release faster.

AccelerationDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoe.value: Moves the camera farther back while accelerating.

ApplyInitialLookAngle_Description.value: Applies configured framing briefly on entry and after framing edits, then returns full camera ownership to Roblox.

BoostBlendSmoothing_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes boost camera effects engage and release faster.

BoostDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Moves the camera farther back during boost.

ConfigNote.value: Roblox owns continuous motion, collision and orbit. V6.1 applies initial framing for only InitialLookApplyFrames frames.

ConfigRefreshSeconds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Waits longer before live config edits are reread.

DebugEnabled_Description.value: Publishes simple live camera diagnostics on Workspace.CurrentCamera.

DefaultDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Moves the normal camera farther from the vehicle.

DefaultHeightStuds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Raises the initial camera position above the vehicle.

DefaultPitchDegrees_RaisingThisDoes.value: Raises the initial camera position and makes it look down more steeply.

DefaultYawDegrees_RaisingThisDoes.value: Rotates the initial camera position farther around the vehicle.

Enabled_Description.value: Turns the default vehicle camera controller on.

HighSpeedDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Moves the camera farther back at high speed.

HighSpeedFieldOfView_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens the view at high speed.

HighSpeedFullMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes high-speed camera effects reach full strength at a higher speed.

HighSpeedStartMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes high-speed camera effects begin at a higher speed.

InitialLookApplyFrames_RaisingThisDoes.value: Applies framing across more initialization frames so Roblox reliably adopts the configured angle; this is not continuous driving control.

LockPlayerZoom_Description.value: Prevents the player changing camera distance while driving.

LookAheadStuds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Moves the initial look target farther ahead of the vehicle.

LookTargetHeightStuds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Raises the initial point the camera looks toward.

RespectTrailerCameraKeys_Description.value: Lets P, C, and V release this controller until B resumes it.

AccelBrakeTiltNotes.value: Positive/negative pitch direction may depend on the live vehicle orientation. If acceleration or braking tilts the wrong way, flip the sign of the matching degrees value.

DriftMiniBoostNotes.value: When DriftMiniBoostRequiresAcceleration is true, releasing drift only grants mini-boost if throttle is above DriftMiniBoostAccelerationThreshold. ReverseMaxMph controls reverse top speed.

InputOwnedSteeringTurnBankNotes.value: Raw left/right input remains the sole bank owner. SteeringDriveMode restores original reverse yaw, retains forward mode while braking, and switches to forward immediately on forward throttle during a three-point turn.

SlopeHoverNotes.value: Fixes uphill/downhill hover-height drift by damping vertical velocity relative to expected slope-following vertical motion instead of raw world-Y velocity. ForceAlongGroundNormal is optional and off by default.

SpeedSteeringNotes.value: LowMultiplier boosts low-speed turning, HighMultiplier softens high-speed turning, CurveExponent controls how aggressively low-speed assist ramps in, ReverseSteeringMultiplier tunes reverse separately, BoostSteeringMultiplier stacks on top while normal boost or drift mini-boost is active.

AccelerationTuningNote.value: Launch* controls 0-14 MPH; PowerBand* controls where tiered pull fades; AerodynamicDrag* controls high-speed resistance.

BoostTuningNote.value: Duration/Recharge min/max seconds are physical bounds; raw V2 boost stats still determine position within them.

DriftTuningNote.value: DriftGrip reduces boat-like slide; EngineAssist and VelocityAlignment pull momentum around the corner; SideForce creates rotation.

HandlingTuningNote.value: SteeringResponse min/max multipliers compress E-S steering without changing rating stats.

OrganisedTuningNote.value: Select one category Folder and edit its numeric Attributes. Each matching _RaisingThisDoes string explains the higher-value effect.

TuningNote.value: Phase 1 longitudinal dynamics. Disable Enabled for immediate legacy-force rollback.
